intro: A tropical archipelago with Bali as the leading digital nomad destination. Well-developed infrastructure and long-term nomad visas.
climate: Tropical, a steady +27-30°C. The rainy season runs from November to March, the dry season from April to October.
mentality: A relaxed pace, respect for hierarchy and religion. A large international nomad community.
language_note: Indonesian (Bahasa) is simple for basic communication. English is found in tourist zones and nomad districts.
visa_note: Visa on Arrival for 30 days. The Digital Nomad Visa (E33G) lasts 5 years and is for remote workers with an income from $60,000. The KITAS is for long-term residency.
